visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation-based intro sequence. A brown, roughly textured background fills the frame. White serif text overlays the center. A colorful logo appears in the top right corner. (2) Fast-paced montage of historical-style imagery. Close-ups of vintage neon signs and shop fronts with 'Bresters' branding. Red and yellow text bars appear over the images to convey historical information. Lighting is high-contrast, mimicking old film. (3) Medium shot of a middle-aged male character with greyish hair tied back and a matching beard. He is wearing a clean, white button-down shirt. He sits in a well-lit indoor studio setting with a bookshelf and white walls in the background. He uses active hand gestures, holding a small yellow sign with blue text while speaking. (4) Close-up shots of the man's face and hands as he continues his narrative. His expressions are serious yet engaging. A person's hand enters from the side holding a microphone-like stick near him. The lighting is bright and even studio lighting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 究竟有多少人會知道. [Logo]: 哈哈台. (2) [Subtitle]: 百樂冰淇淋店 其實跟當年轟動一時的 瑠公圳分屍案 是有關係的呢？ [Logo]: Bresters. (3) [Slogan]: 搜索瑠公圳電影導演 賴俊羽. (4) [Subtitle]: 這故事是發生在 1961年的台北. (5) [Subtitle]: 就是有幾個工兵學校的學生 他在台大校門口的水溝 發現了一個屍包. (6) [Subtitle]: 警察在那個屍包裡面 發現證據跟... 當時的一個空軍英雄(柳哲生) 有關這樣子. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以大家都把他(柳哲生) 當成是嫌犯. (8) [Subtitle]: 但那時候是戒嚴時期 其實像這種比較權貴的 外省將軍、軍人他們是位高權重 其實媒體是不能隨便報導. (9) [Subtitle]: 但是在那個時候卻有... 大批的媒體都寫他(柳哲生)是兇手. (10) [Subtitle]: 而且他是一個在... 對日抗戰的時候擊落最佳... 最多敵機的一個空軍將軍. (11) [Subtitle]: 但卻因為這個案子呢 大家說他是兇手這樣子. (12) [Subtitle]: 那最後他為了要自清 然後甚至他乾脆就辭官 然後就開了一家百樂冰淇淋. (13) [Subtitle]: 就是在那個時代下 應該是媒體控制會很嚴格嘛. (14) [Subtitle]: 但是大家卻突然間 愛講什麼就講什麼. (15) [Subtitle]: 這樣其實反觀現在 其實現在的狀態也跟以前一樣 媒體會帶動風向這件事情 從古至今都是一樣的. (16) [Subtitle]: 就是讓觀眾他們可以去思考說其實 媒體這件事情其實是 會影響你的判斷. (17) [Subtitle]: 我們還是也要有一個自主 能夠求證或判斷或懷疑的 媒體識讀的部分. (18) [Variety]: 對對對. [Variety]: 對啊.
